title: Compose provider telemetry with the scheduler usage authority
description:
SPIDR slice 3 of 4, cut from task-8e3076177f87458f934a776eca68ba16. This is the RULES slice and the heart of the original task: the daemon-side composition of runner telemetry with the scheduler usage authority.

Hard dependencies: task-8e3076177f87458f934a776eca68ba16 (record contract) and the canonical codec slice, both DONE.

DELIVERABLE: apps/daemon/src/telemetry/provider-run-normalize.ts plus its .js bridge and provider-run-normalize.test.ts.

BEHAVIOUR:
- Import ONLY from the @moe/runner and @moe/scheduler package ROOTS via bare specifiers. A deep path into packages/** fails with TS6059; this repo has no tsconfig paths and no project references, so there is no escape hatch.
- Validate ONE raw launch-bound ClaudeTelemetryHandoff. Refuse a malformed handoff with a stable code and layer.
- Delegate EVERY usage envelope to production normalizeUsageMeasurement, IN ORIGINAL PROVIDER SEQUENCE, threading the previous accepted NormalizedMeasurement as the `prior` argument. Threading `prior` is not bookkeeping: it is what makes BUDGET_OBSERVATION_SEQUENCE_GAP, SEQUENCE_REGRESSION, IDENTITY_CONFLICT and STREAM_MISMATCH reachable at all. Passing null every time silently disables four of the ten measurement codes and no test can tell.
- COPY NONE of the authority's source/coverage matrix. If the daemon decides COMPLETE vs PARTIAL vs UNKNOWN, or picks a BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_SOURCES member itself, the authority has been duplicated.
- PRESERVE BOTH PROVENANCES SEPARATELY. The upstream ProviderTelemetryRefusal {code: ProviderTelemetryCode, layer: ProviderTelemetryLayer} and the scheduler's LayeredIssue {layer: "CONTRACT"|"MEASUREMENT", code} occupy DIFFERENT record fields. Do not flatten, translate, or invent a pass.
- UNKNOWN usage retains quantity null and the exact upstream code/layer. PARTIAL retains its measured lower bound. No client-estimated Claude cost may be persisted with source ACTUAL_BILLED.

MEASURED CONTEXT (re-measure before planning; taken at HEAD 5c5afb1):
- DEPENDENCY EDGE VERIFIED on all three clauses. apps/daemon/package.json declares @moe/runner and @moe/scheduler; pnpm-lock.yaml:87-112 carries the apps/daemon importer; a compiled probe importing parseClaudeResultTelemetry and launchClaudeWithTelemetry from the BARE "@moe/runner" typechecked exit 0, with a negative control failing TS2305 exit 1.
- TRAP: `grep telemetry packages/runner/src/index.ts` returns ZERO hits and is a FALSE NEGATIVE. The surface is re-exported through `export * from "./surface/claude-surface.js"` at index.ts:162; claude-surface.ts:167-212 re-exports all three telemetry modules by name. Do not report blocked on the grep.
- normalizeUsageMeasurement(input: unknown, prior?: NormalizedMeasurement | null): MeasurementResult<NormalizedMeasurement> at packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-measurement.ts:210. Input is a {measurement, pricebookBinding, truncated} envelope.
- ClaudeTelemetryHandoff at packages/runner/src/providers/telemetry/claude-telemetry-launch.ts:70-86.
- BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_SOURCES has SIX members: PROVIDER_REPORTED_COMPLETE, PROVIDER_REPORTED_PARTIAL, DERIVED_LIST_PRICE, SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA, ACTUAL_BILLED, UNKNOWN.

Scope: apps/daemon/src/telemetry/provider-run-normalize.* only. Persistence belongs to the ledger slice.

Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner test, pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test, pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck, pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test - each leg's exit code read SEPARATELY.
definitionOfDone: The module imports only @moe/runner and @moe/scheduler public roots by bare specifier, validates one raw launch-bound ClaudeTelemetryHandoff, and refuses a malformed handoff with a stable code naming its layer.

Every usage envelope is delegated to production normalizeUsageMeasurement in original provider sequence with the previous accepted record threaded as `prior`, proven by a test where an out-of-order or duplicate-identity envelope surfaces the scheduler's own sequence or identity code.
No source/coverage decision is made locally: grep shows the daemon never selects a BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_SOURCES member or a coverage class itself, and no test injects a fake normalizer.

Upstream ProviderTelemetryRefusal code/layer and scheduler LayeredIssue CONTRACT/MEASUREMENT code/layer are retained in separate record fields, with a test asserting BOTH codes AND which layer answered for an upstream refusal and a scheduler refusal separately.

UNKNOWN retains quantity null with the exact upstream code/layer, PARTIAL retains its measured lower bound, and a hostile case feeding a client-estimated Claude cost asserts the persisted source is NOT ACTUAL_BILLED.

A sweep covers all six BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_SOURCES members and asserts the generated case count equals the length of the imported production array, so a sweep producing zero or partial cases reddens instead of passing silently.

Every added assertion is proven load-bearing by a mutation drill naming the test that reddens, restored and verified by sha256 rather than git diff, and fresh runner/scheduler/daemon-typecheck/daemon-test legs each exit 0 with exit codes read separately.
taskRails: Daemon is the direction-safe composition boundary; runner must not depend on scheduler and tests must not inject a fake normalizer.
Preserve upstream provider reason code/layer separately from scheduler CONTRACT/MEASUREMENT code/layer; do not flatten or invent a pass.
Import only from @moe/runner and @moe/scheduler package roots. A deep relative import fails TS6059 and there is no tsconfig paths escape hatch.
Compose normalizeUsageMeasurement; never re-derive its source/coverage matrix. Re-implementing a landed authority is a silent duplicate that collides with its owner.
Scope is apps/daemon/src/telemetry/provider-run-normalize.* only. Persistence belongs to the ledger slice.
